description: Record one beat: the narrated line (say) and the steps it covers, performed on camera with natural pointer motion (hover states show; no cursor is drawn: tday draws it). The footage holds until the line has had time to be said. Only beats are footage: anything between them is cut. A beat whose step fails is not kept (put the app back with demo_view steps and record it again). focus: what the line is about when it is not a clicked control (a total, a result row; terminal: { match: regex }); payoff: the one beat with the result the viewer should remember; give it a focus on the component that shows that result (tday highlights it). shot sets the title card's product shot, a piece of the opening screen shown alone that lands where it stands when the video starts: give shot.area on the FIRST beat (measured on the opening screen, before its steps; ignored on later beats); size, motion, layout or off on any beat, the latest wins. thumbnail picks the film's thumbnail on any beat: still (a still picture of the product shot; the video plays as recorded), shot (the title card with the product shot), card (the title card) or frame (this beat's last frame); the latest pick wins. Typing a $env: value on camera is refused. Returns tday's narration notes on the line, when tday answers.

caption.description: What the caption shows instead of say: the literal form of something spoken (say "slash approve", caption "/approve"), or a shorter version of a long line

companionDo.description: With companions: steps run in them during this beat, at the same time as do: a terminal's (type, press, run, wait, wait_for) or a browser window's (the web steps except upload). Steps for one companion run in order; different companions' run at the same time. Every companion is filmed in every beat, with steps or without (live)

action.description: web/electron: open, click, type, select, hover, scroll, press, drag, upload, wait. terminal: type, press, run, wait_for. ios/android: open, click, type, press, scroll, drag, wait (see demo_start's ios). upload clicks the target (the app's upload button or drop zone) and answers the file picker it opens, on camera, with the file in value

view.description: With companions: what the film shows from this beat on, until you change it: a companion's name when what matters is happening there (the agent or CLI working, the other view), "app" to go back to the app ("companion" or "terminal" is the first companion). The take starts on "app". You decide; the film cuts on the beat where you switch
